# netbox_l2vpn_termination (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/vpn/l2vpntermination/):

> An L2VPN termination attaches a VLAN, an interface or a VM interface to an L2VPN.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_l2vpn_termination" "example" {
  l2vpn_id             = netbox_l2vpn.example.id
  assigned_object_type = "ipam.vlan"
  assigned_object_id   = netbox_vlan.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `assigned_object_id` (Number)
- `assigned_object_type` (String)
- `l2vpn_id` (Number)

### Optional

- `custom_fields` (Map of String)
- `tags` (Set of String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags_all` (Set of String)
